title: Systematic Bias in Green Patent Classification: Silent Green and False Green
abstract: arXiv:2608.23420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Green-patent indicators built on Cooperative Patent Classification Y02 tags are widely used in research, policy, and investment, yet their construct validity has not been audited at corpus scale. We assess whether Y02 is systematically biased and whether that bias may reinforce the ESG innovation disconnect. We introduce an Error-as-Signal framework that treats disagreement between an administrative label and an independent model as diagnostic evidence of measurement error. Screening 9,075,421 USPTO granted patents (1962-2024) with a fine-tuned domain model against Y02 yields 517,772 disagreements. Two independent open-weight large language models then judge by consensus whether each flagged invention has a direct climate-mitigation or adaptation function. translated_title: 绿色专利分类中的系统性偏差：隐性绿色与虚假绿色
translated_abstract: 基于合作专利分类Y02标签的绿色专利指标广泛应用于研究、政策和投资领域，但其结构效度尚未在语料库规模上进行审计。我们评估Y02是否存在系统性偏差，以及这种偏差是否可能加剧ESG创新脱节。我们引入了一种“误差即信号”框架，将行政标签与独立模型之间的不一致视为测量误差的诊断性证据。通过使用微调领域模型对9,075,421项美国授权专利（1962-2024年）进行筛查，与Y02对照产生了517,772个不一致项。两个独立的开源大语言模型随后通过共识判断每个被标记的发明是否具有直接的气候缓解或适应功能。我们识别出180,384个行政性第一类错误（虚假绿色），集中在数字数据处理、无线网络、数字通信和半导体领域，以及29,465个第二类错误（隐性绿色），后者可能被低估，从而加剧了ESG创新脱节。
tldr: 本研究通过“误差即信号”框架和大规模专利筛查，揭示了绿色专利分类Y02标签存在系统性偏差，识别出大量“虚假绿色”和“隐性绿色”专利，可能加剧ESG创新脱节。
en_tdlr: This study reveals systematic bias in Y02 green patent classification through an Error-as-Signal framework, identifying numerous "false green" and "silent green" patents that may worsen the ESG innovation disconnect.
